1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeChainRegions
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FixedFrameChains
3 
4 /-! The two end kites of any actual simple cut-tree chain are separated
5 in the single global development already chosen for all its triangles. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set Real Wedge
10 
11 namespace CutTreeChain
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} {n : ℕ}
14     (chain : CutTreeChain T n) (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
15 
16 theorem incoming_kite_global (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
17     charts.kite (chain.edge i.castSucc) = charts.frames.frame (chain.vertex i.succ.castSucc) ''
18       ((chain.fan charts i).edgeTriangles (chain.edge i.castSucc).symm).developedKite := by
19   rw [charts.kite_reverse (chain.edge i.castSucc)]
20   exact charts.kite_at_fan _ (charts.internal_nonvertex (chain.edge i.castSucc).symm
21     (chain.edge i.succ) (chain.internal_neighbors_different i))
22 
23 theorem outgoing_kite_global (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
24     charts.kite (chain.edge i.succ) = charts.frames.frame (chain.vertex i.succ.castSucc) ''
25       ((chain.fan charts i).edgeTriangles (chain.edge i.succ)).developedKite :=
26   charts.kite_at_fan _ (charts.internal_nonvertex (chain.edge i.castSucc).symm
27     (chain.edge i.succ) (chain.internal_neighbors_different i))
28 
29 /-- Apply all intermediate moves in their fixed global frames, with the actual end kites. -/
30 theorem end_kites_nonoverlap (total : (∑ i, chain.sourceAngle charts i) < π) :
31     Disjoint (charts.kite (chain.edge 0))
32       (interior (charts.kite (chain.edge (Fin.last n).succ))) := by
33   classical
34   let steps (i : Fin n) : RegionStep (chain.region charts i.castSucc) (chain.region charts i.succ)
35       (chain.middleKite charts i) := (chain.region_step charts total i).choose
36   have motions (i : Fin n) : (steps i).motion = charts.frames.transition (chain.edge i.succ.castSucc) :=
37     (chain.region_step charts total i).choose_spec
38   let frames (i : Fin (n + 1)) := charts.frames.frame (chain.vertex i.succ.castSucc)
39   have compatible (i : Fin n) (x : Plane) : frames i.succ ((steps i).motion x) = frames i.castSucc x := by
40     rw [motions i]
41     exact charts.frames.compatible (chain.edge i.succ.castSucc) x
42   have result := finite_index_chain_endpoint_separation n (chain.region charts) (chain.middleKite charts)
43     steps frames compatible
44     ((chain.fan charts 0).edgeTriangles (chain.edge 0).symm).developedKite
45     ((chain.fan charts (Fin.last n)).edgeTriangles (chain.edge (Fin.last n).succ)).developedKite
46     (chain.first_kite_in_region charts) (chain.region_avoids_outgoing charts total (Fin.last n))
47   have first : charts.kite (chain.edge 0) = frames 0 ''
48       ((chain.fan charts 0).edgeTriangles (chain.edge 0).symm).developedKite :=
49     chain.incoming_kite_global charts 0
50   have last := chain.outgoing_kite_global charts (Fin.last n)
51   dsimp only [frames] at result
52   rw [first, last]
53   exact result
54 
55 end CutTreeChain
56 
57 namespace SixVertexGraph
58 
59 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
60   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
61     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
62 
63 include small_faces in
64 /-- The source cone discharges every numerical premise of the global chain separation. -/
65 theorem cut_tree_chain_end_kites_nonoverlap {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
66     (charts : CutTreeCharts T) {n : ℕ} (chain : CutTreeChain T n)
67     (source : Fin 6) (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space)) :
68     Disjoint (charts.kite (chain.edge 0))
69       (interior (charts.kite (chain.edge (Fin.last n).succ))) :=
70   chain.end_kites_nonoverlap charts (graph.cut_tree_chain_source_budget small_faces T charts chain source at_source)
71 
72 end SixVertexGraph
73 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
